title: Training-Free Continual Learning for Multimodal Forecasting via Prompt Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2610.27468v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Adapting a forecasting system to a changing world classically means retraining. We ask whether the task of continually learning regimes for time series forecasting can be represented by a piece of text: a guidance block, evolved by outcome-driven reflection and used in a frozen LLM forecaster's prompt. On a refreshed multimodal benchmark (weekly search indices, daily currencies, daily commodities, each window paired with web-retrieved news), we run GEPA-style prompt evolution under strict contamination control to prevent the data leakage common in timeseries benchmarks: the forecaster's knowledge cutoff predates every evaluated window. A 900-word evolved guidance carried by Llama-3.3-70B beats TimeSeries Foundation Models (TSFMs) on held-out data (GM MASE 0.776 vs. 0.898 for TabPFN-TS-3), transfers to more recent models without measurable loss, and costs dollars rather than GPU-days to update. We characterize the loop: out-of-loop gain

translated_title: 基于提示演化的免训练多模态预测持续学习
translated_abstract: 使预测系统适应不断变化的世界，传统上意味着重新训练。我们提出这样一个问题：时间序列预测中持续学习不同状态的任务，能否用一段文本来表示——即一个引导模块，通过结果驱动的反思进行演化，并被嵌入到冻结的LLM预测器的提示中。在一个更新的多模态基准上（每周搜索指数、每日汇率、每日大宗商品，每个时间窗口均配有从网络检索到的新闻），我们在严格的污染控制下运行GEPA式提示演化，以防止时间序列基准中常见的数据泄露问题：预测器的知识截止日期早于每一个被评估的窗口。由Llama-3.3-70B承载的900词演化引导模块在留出数据上击败了时间序列基础模型（TSFMs）（GM MASE 0.776 对比 TabPFN-TS-3 的 0.898），并能迁移到更新的模型而不产生可测量的性能损失，且更新成本仅需几美元而非数个GPU天。我们对该循环进行了刻画：环外增益
tldr: 该论文提出通过结果驱动反思演化的文本引导模块，使冻结的LLM预测器无需重新训练即可实现时间序列持续学习，在严格防止数据泄露的多模态基准上超越时间序列基础模型，且更新成本从GPU天级降至美元级。
en_tdlr: An outcome-reflection-evolved text guidance block enables a frozen LLM forecaster to continually learn new regimes training-free, beating time series foundation models on contamination-controlled multimodal benchmarks at a cost of dollars instead of GPU-days.
